amendment_note: Reconciled during Phase 1B Forensic Amendment Gate to strictly match Phase 1A.7.1 approved April baseline scenes.

scientific_scope.climatological_limitation: Explicitly does NOT constitute a 30-year WMO long-term climate change trend. Captures inter-annual pre-monsoon variability, spatial persistence, and current-state anomalies.
scientific_scope.window_type: Peak-Summer Pre-Monsoon (April 11 to April 24, DOY 101 to 114)

temporal_quality_and_missing_data_policy.annual_cell_validity_rule: A cell is valid in year k iff clear/unmasked pixel fraction >= 0.70 (qa_mask == 1).
temporal_quality_and_missing_data_policy.insufficient_coverage_rule: If a cell has < 4 valid annual observations, baseline mean/median/std are null and cell is marked INSUFFICIENT_HISTORICAL_COVERAGE.
temporal_quality_and_missing_data_policy.persistence_denominator_rule: Persistence frequency is strictly divided by K_valid (the number of valid years for that cell), and K_valid is preserved in metadata.
temporal_quality_and_missing_data_policy.recurrence_policy: Extreme heat recurrence is an integer count of valid years with LST >= 45.0C; if K_valid < 5, flagged as partial_temporal_record.
temporal_quality_and_missing_data_policy.anomaly_eligibility_rule: 2025 anomaly is valid iff both K_valid >= 4 and 2025 observation has valid pixel fraction >= 0.70.

lst_persistence_p75.name: Heat Persistence (Top Quartile Frequency)
lst_persistence_p75.formula: sum([I(LST_k >= P75(LST_citywide, k)) for k in valid_years]) / K_valid
lst_persistence_p75.interpretation: Proportion of valid baseline years where cell was in the city-wide top 25% hottest areas

lst_recurrence_ge45.name: Extreme LST Recurrence (>= 45C)
lst_recurrence_ge45.interpretation: Number of valid annual observations with LST >= 45.0C (CLIMORA methodological threshold, not epidemiological heat-health threshold)

sensor_isolation_matrix.sentinel2_role: High-resolution 10m/20m current-state reference (S2A_T43QCA_20250118T053348_L2A); strictly isolated from 5-year Landsat baseline stack.
sensor_isolation_matrix.modis_role: Coarse ~1km 8-day composite thermal context; macro-validation only; never upscaled to 30m.
sensor_isolation_matrix.nasa_power_role: Daily surface meteorology (T2M_MAX, RH2M, solar radiation); provides synoptic meteorological context on acquisition dates.

cross_sensor_calibration_policy.landsat8_vs_landsat9: Both platforms calibrated to USGS Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Reflectance and Surface Temperature algorithms; inter-sensor radiometric agreement within +/- 0.3 K; no empirical fudge factors applied; sensor identity preserved in metadata.
